snippet.title: Blood Refreshed Supply | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
Get ready for a hell of a good time with Blood: Refreshed Supply coming soon to all platforms now with the Death Wish expansion!

Blood: Refreshed Supply rises once again with Death Wish, remastered visuals, new maps for Episodes 1-3, and a brand new Episode 4! This free expansion will be coming soon March 2026.

===========================
Coming soon!
